metric_definition.violation_doc: A document listed in constraint_violating_doc_ids; if absent, fallback to topical_relevant_doc_ids minus constraint_satisfying_doc_ids.
metric_definition.violation_at_k: Probability that at least one violating document appears within top-k, averaged over queries.
metric_definition.first_violating_rank: Rank position of the first violating document within top-10; 11 means none found.
metric_definition.build_time: Wall-clock build time in seconds for model loading, document encoding, index construction, and cache initialization before online queries.
metric_definition.spend_time: Wall-clock execution time in seconds for the online query stage over all queries in this report.
metric_definition.total_time: Sum of build_time and spend_time in seconds.
metric_definition.api_cost: Accumulated API cost in USD reported by the provider response when available; otherwise 0.0.
metric_definition.api_token: Accumulated API tokens reported by the provider response when available; otherwise 0.
metric_definition.coder: CoDeR combines encoder A and encoder B scores with alpha weighting and tau filtering, mirroring eval_retrieval_metrics.py.
